Repo: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa, branch feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component.

REWORK round 1 of 3 on Step 2 (ZimmSizeChip atom + ZimmSizeChipGroup molecule) of the SFCC-236 build. The Scorer independently reproduced two real defects via live mutation testing (not just review) and returned REWORK with three authorized fixes. Do ONLY these three. A fourth finding (missing i18n extraction) was explicitly deferred to Marcel's report — do NOT touch any translations/*.json file.

## Fix 1 — tautological test assertion
File: `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup/index.test.tsx`, around line 98.
Currently: `expect(stops[0]).toHaveTextContent('S');`
This is inside the test "falls back to the first ENABLED size when the first size is disabled" — the Scorer proved this assertion is a tautology: `toHaveTextContent` does substring matching, and if the code regresses to fall back to a DISABLED 'XS' chip instead of skipping to the enabled 'S' chip, the assertion still passes because `'XS'.includes('S') === true`. Reproduced live: mutating `firstEnabledIndex` to unconditionally `return 0` made this test pass when it should fail.

Fix: change the assertion to check DOM identity, not text substring — e.g.:
```ts
expect(stops[0]).toHaveAttribute('data-size-value', 's');
```
(match whatever the actual lowercase/value convention is in this file's existing `data-size-value` usage — check how the component itself sets this attribute and use the identical value format). Verify after the fix: temporarily reintroduce the `firstEnabledIndex` mutation, confirm this specific test NOW fails, then revert and confirm it passes again — prove the fix actually closes the gap before moving on.

## Fix 2 — untested colour-precedence logic (new file authorized)
File: `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSizeChip/zimmSizeChip.css.ts`, lines ~13-29.
Three colour resolver functions (`resolveBorderColour`, `resolveBackgroundColour`, `resolveTextColour`) are currently module-private (not exported). Because `index.test.tsx` globally mocks `useMultiStyleConfig`, these resolvers are NEVER invoked by any shipped test — the Scorer proved this by inverting the disabled/selected precedence order in `resolveTextColour` and running the ENTIRE 722-test suite: 100% green, meaning a real rendering defect (a disabled+selected chip getting the wrong text colour) would ship completely undetected.

Fix, in two parts:
(a) Export all three resolver functions from `zimmSizeChip.css.ts` (add `export` to each).
(b) Create a NEW file `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSizeChip/zimmSizeChip.css.test.ts`, mirroring the exact structure of the existing precedent `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmTextInput/zimmTextInput.css.test.ts` (read it first, in full, before writing anything — copy its testing pattern for exported style-resolver functions exactly). At minimum, cover:
   - One precedence-order test per resolver (default vs selected vs disabled, confirming the right one wins when multiple flags could apply).
   - An explicit `{selected: true, disabled: true}` case for each resolver — this is the exact combination the Scorer proved regresses silently today. Assert the disabled treatment wins over the selected treatment (that's the correct real-world semantic: a disabled option shouldn't look selectable/selected even if some upstream state marked it selected).

This new file is pre-authorized — same CODEOWNERS boundary as the rest of this step (`ui-kits/`), no new tooling, direct precedent already in-repo. Do not export anything else from `zimmSizeChip.css.ts` beyond the three named resolvers.

## Fix 3 — wrong semantic token category (zero-visual-diff swap)
File: `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSizeChip/zimmSizeChip.css.ts`, lines ~15 and ~21.
- Line 15, inside `resolveBorderColour`'s selected branch: change `'var(--zimm-color-text-default)'` to `'var(--zimm-color-border-focus)'` (matches the precedent at `zimmColourSwatch.css.ts:22`).
- Line 21, inside `resolveBackgroundColour`'s selected branch: change `'var(--zimm-color-text-default)'` to `'var(--zimm-color-bg-05)'` (matches the precedent already fixed in Step 1's `zimmSlideIndicator.css.ts:48`).
Both new tokens resolve to the identical value as the old one (`grey[900]`/`#191919` — verify this yourself in `overrides/app/theme/foundation/colour.ts` before making the change, don't just trust this description). Zero visual diff — this only fixes which semantic *category* of token is used on which CSS property.
Leave `resolveTextColour` and every other branch untouched.

## Explicitly do NOT do this round
- Do NOT touch any file under `translations/` — the i18n extraction gap is deferred to Marcel's report, not this round's job.
- Do NOT touch `zimmColourSwatch`, `zimmColourSwatchGroup`, `zimmTextInput`, `zimmSlideIndicator`, or any file outside the two components in this step (read `zimmTextInput.css.test.ts` for reference, but do not modify it).
- Do NOT add `rerender()`-based tests — that was noted as "recommended, not blocking" by the Scorer; skip it, keep this round tightly scoped to the three named fixes.

## After making all fixes, verify:
```
npx tsc --noEmit
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSizeChip overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts
npx vitest run overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts
npx eslint overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSizeChip overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup
node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs
npm run test
```
All must be clean/green. Confirm via `git status --porcelain` that only the expected files changed: the 2-line-ish edits in `zimmSizeChip.css.ts`, the 1-line edit in `zimmSizeChipGroup/index.test.tsx`, the 1 new file `zimmSizeChip.css.test.ts`, plus the pre-existing Step 1 commit and the unchanged 2-line theme/components/index.ts diff from earlier in Step 2. Do NOT stage or commit. Report exactly what changed, the new test file's contents summary, and confirm the two falsification-and-revert proofs (Fix 1's re-mutation test, and ideally a similar proof for Fix 2's new tests actually catching the precedence bug).

7	 * and that it is NOT floating dots; per-segment width/gap and the exact colour pairing are not
8	 * broken out in the export handed to this step, so both are treated as open design decisions
9	 * (documented below) rather than invented pixel-for-pixel guesses — same precedent as
10	 * zimmColourSwatchGroup's `pagination` part leaving an unconfirmed inter-button gap at the flex
11	 * default rather than inventing one.
12	 *
13	 * Two parts:
14	 *   - `root` — the full-width flex strip, exactly `--zimm-scale-025` (1px) tall.
15	 *   - `dot` — one equal-width segment per image (despite the part name, this renders as a
16	 *     rectangle in a hairline, not a circular dot — the name matches this component's
17	 *     already-agreed contract, not a literal shape description).

20	  parts: ['root', 'dot'],
21	
22	  baseStyle: ({ isActive }: { isActive?: boolean }): Record<string, SystemStyleObject> => ({
23	    root: {
24	      display: 'flex',
25	      // Fluid, not a fixed Figma px width — matches the product card's own "fluid, not 288px"
